text: I was willing to give this a fair chance, however, during my testing, it didn't insert a proper colon in my sentences, and when I said laughing face emoji, it wouldn't even insert that, all it did was spell the word. I was willing to live with a little bit of mishaps like that, but then I saw the ridiculous prices for monthly/yearly. I'm willing to pay a one-time fee $19.99, and that's it. When I say "it", this thing spells the word "I" uninstalling... 📤
replyText: Sorry about the colon, emoji and “it”/”I” issues. We’ve flagged them all for improvement. Your feedback on pricing is noted too. Thanks for taking the time to test so carefully!
